text:
deploy-bot: Starting unpin window: runtime v5.0 -> v5.1 in ap-southeast-1 at 02:00 UTC. Target models: gptx-lite, llama-mini-int8. Rollout: 10% -> 40% -> 80% -> 100%. Auto-rollback enabled.

carla: Quick note: v5.1 introduces a changed attention tiling that affected batch scheduling. In small-batch workloads we saw p95 +9% for gptx-lite in internal sims.

dez: Are those sims representative of prod longseq? Sequence length was 512 in sims. Our prod longseqs often hit 2048.

mike: We ran a short 2048 run in canary and saw p95 +12% for gptx-lite, but tradeoff was 18% lower token-cost. Need to decide abort threshold.

infra-watch: Ops checklist:
1) Canary in ap-southeast-1 at 10%
2) Telemetry: latency.p95, errors, host.mem, kvcache.hit
3) Abort if p95 delta > 10% OR errors > 0.4%
4) Rollback cmd: infractl rollback --runtime v5.1 --region ap-southeast-1

tara: SDK note: we still have ~5 routes pinned to sdk-2.5 which won't accept the new routing header in v5.1. Recommend excluding sdk-2.5 from canary.

deploy-bot: I can apply routing exclude `sdk_version ~ "^2\.5"` for canary groups. Shall I?

carla: Yes, exclude 2.5. Also add a shadow run for sdk-2.5 traffic to collect errors.

dez: If p95 crosses 10% but errors remain low, my preference is to pause and run an optimizer micro-patch rather than immediate rollback. Patch estimate ~35m including smoke.

mike: Agree with pause-first for low-error cases. If mem also spikes >200MB, prefer rollback.

deploy-bot: Canary started 6361112225. Exclude rule applied. Shadow job queued for sdk-2.5.

infra-watch: Canary update 6361112235: gptx-lite p95 +11.7%, errors 0.03%, mem +80MB, kvcache.hit slightly lower.

carla: p95 > 10% threshold. I recommend pause and trigger micro-patch workflow. If micro-patch doesn't land within 45m, we rollback.

tara: I'll message CSMs for the 5 sdk-2.5 routes and note shadow collection.

deploy-bot: Action: paused rollout at 10% (pause id 6361112222). To abort fully reply `abort` or run `deploy-bot pause 6361112222` again.

mike: I'll start the optimizer PR branch and ping when ready for quick re-canary.

carla: Thanks team. Please log incident if optimizer fails to converge. We should include this in the release note; call out p95 regressions and sdk gating.
